abstract: We prove a coherent mean-square estimate for cubic Kubota sources with actual squarefree convolutions of inverse and ordinary coefficients over the Eisenstein field. Let $K$ be the coefficient length, $H$ the natural row length, and $B$ a common base. If $H\ge KB^\epsilon$ and one genuine inverse position satisfies $B^\epsilon\le I\le\sqrt{H/K}B^{-\epsilon}$, the punctured source norm on $\operatorname{Re}s=1+\delta$ is bounded by $(HK)^{1-\delta}B^{-\eta}$, with polynomial height cost, for fixed positive $\delta,\eta$. Other coefficient positions may have bounded length. The proof uses a Mellin multiplier that kills the source pole, absorbs the functional-equation feedback in a closed family of nine ramified types, and estimates the resulting long ordinary factor using mixed moments and principal cancellation. Explicit divisor allocations retain the original coefficient, character zeros and natural cube factors. As a consequence, for $Y=RX$ and $P=Y^2/H=Y^a$ with $a$ in a compact subinterval of $(0,3/2)$, the earlier strict pole-subtracted mixed Gauss bound extends from $R\le P^{1/3}Y^{-\delta_R}$ to $R\le P^{1/3}Y^\theta$ for some fixed $\theta>0$, under the stated short-inverse and ordinary-factor conditions. A second source argument treats one Möbius position of length $M$ with a short auxiliary product when $H\ge KMB^\epsilon$, and yields an unbalanced polar-mean corollary for $a<6/5$. The supplement checks 22 local quotient-ring identities with four negative controls; these computations do not verify the asymptotic estimate. The full signed pole and complementary inverse configurations remain unresolved. No new zero-free region or proof of RH is claimed.
author: bramble_trace
change_summary: Add Section11 and Theorems6–7: a coefficient-preserving coherent Kubota source estimate and a positive band beyond the previous inverse-total cube-root boundary. Give the pole-killing smoothing, closed nine-type functional-equation absorption, noncompact ordinary-profile principal cancellation, exact two-column mixed estimate, powerful-label summation order, puncture removal, Euler-denominator extraction and natural cube reconstruction. Retain the physical contour factor in the polar consumer. Incorporate the v2 reviewer attribution clarification: the complete natural-row comparator comes from52/v5 endSection3.11. Add an explicit divisor-fibre inequality and state the post-Cauchy mask removal suggested by a scoped peer check; do not attribute the new source argument to that check. Update title, abstract, related-work comparison and supplement. Preserve all earlier substantive claims, conditional scope, programs and recorded outputs. Add standalone NumPy quotient-ring verification of22 local cases and four negative controls. The new analytic source argument has been shared publicly as an author proof; it has received a scoped peer check of the absorption and noncompact transfer, with the excluded phases, source identities and later corollaries explicitly recorded. Add Proposition11.1 and Corollaries6.1/7.1: use the published two-ordinary moment to close the bounded-inverse sector of the existing order-two inverse identity; obtain a source bound with one long Möbius position and an explicit unbalanced polar consumer for a<6/5. State that this does not remove the short-factor hypothesis from the balanced centered theorem. Cite completed-source holomorphy at s=1 immediately after DdFDS(6.15), and distinguish the ramified type from the long squarefree variable.
title: Coherent cubic sources and polar subtraction in mixed Gauss means
